title: Algorithmic Fairness in NLP: Persona-Infused LLMs for Human-Centric Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing hate speech detection performance (F1, false positive, and false negative rates) on anti-Black content when using Black (in-group) versus White (out-group) LLM personas.
Comparing hate speech detection performance on anti-Mexican content when using Mexican (in-group) versus White (out-group) LLM personas.
Comparing hate speech detection performance on anti-Muslim and anti-Jewish content when using in-group (Muslim, Jewish) versus out-group (Catholic) LLM personas.
Comparing hate speech detection performance on anti-LGBTQ content when using LGBTQ (in-group) versus Straight (out-group) LLM personas.
Comparing hate speech detection performance on anti-Women content when using Women (in-group) versus Men (out-group) LLM personas.
